```plato
    // Total order by seconds since the epoch.
    LessThanOrEquals(a: Instant, b: Instant): Boolean
        => a.SecondsSinceEpoch <= b.SecondsSinceEpoch;
```

```plato

    //==
    // # FrameTime and BeatTime — the IComparable fills
    //
    // Both order along their own time line, so both compare on their count. For
    // FrameTime that is the FRAME NUMBER, not the wall-clock instant: comparing
    // two frame times under different rates would need a common time line, and
    // silently converting would make the order depend on a field the caller may
    // not have meant to vary. Convert to Instant first if that is the question.

    // Frame positions order by frame number. Precondition: both share a rate.
    LessThanOrEquals(a: FrameTime, b: FrameTime): Boolean
        => a.Frame <= b.Frame;
```
